headline: Statistics Sweden Reports Preliminary Housing Construction Starts for Q1-Q3 2026
summary: Statistics Sweden released preliminary data detailing new housing construction starts across Sweden during the first three quarters of 2026.
why: Statistics Sweden is the national statistical agency, and housing construction figures provide key insights into residential investment and real estate market health.

impacts.name: Sweden
impacts.why: Housing construction start statistics track real estate sector momentum in Sweden.
